heading: Monday, August 3, 2026
topLine: Quanta: how AI reshaped the Erdős-problems community. Also: Alibaba releases Qwen3.8-Max.

items.headline: Quanta: how AI reshaped the Erdős-problems community
items.summary: Quanta Magazine reported on reactions inside the erdosproblems.com community. Noga Alon said he had stopped working on Erdős problems once AI began solving them. Thomas Bloom worried about long AI-generated papers that "no human is going to read". The piece also reported that Terence Tao had stepped back from the community.

items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3.8-Max
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Max, a sparse MoE model with 2.4 trillion parameters, became broadly available as a hosted model with image input, a non-thinking mode and a default 1M-token context. Alibaba reports top scores on several of its own benchmarks against GPT-5.6 and Claude Fable 5.
